tagline.en: Orange SA official travel eSIM: data, calls and SMS in 200+ destinations
tagline.zh: Orange SA 官方旅行 eSIM：200+ 目的地含通话短信

description.en: Orange Travel is the official travel eSIM brand of Orange SA (France) - a real carrier product rather than a reseller. Plans cover 200+ destinations with data-only or data+calls+SMS options, 7/14/30/90-day lengths and top-up/reuse on the same eSIM.

details.en:
Orange Travel is the official travel brand of French carrier group Orange SA (travel.orange.com) - fundamentally different from resellers: it rides Orange group operator partnerships, offers both data-only and data+calls+SMS plan shapes in 7/14/30/90-day lengths, with 1-500GB allowances and 24/7 support stated on its official app listing.

Buying and activation: pick a destination on the web or in the app; in-app activation is one click (no QR scan), and the same eSIM can be topped up repeatedly - no card swap when your destination changes. Prices (rendered from the destination grid, 2026-11-10): from $4.99, with $5.99/$9.99/$19.99/$34.99/$57.99 tiers visible; allowances bind at checkout.

Notes: as a major-carrier product the entry price sits above reseller brands; promo codes (such as 5% off in-app) are time-limited - trust the checkout page; and plan names/allowances only attach at the final step, so comparison shopping takes patience.
details.zh:
Orange Travel 是法国电信巨头 Orange SA 的官方旅行品牌（travel.orange.com），与转售商有本质区别：底层是 Orange 集团的运营商合作网络，提供纯流量与「流量+通话+短信」两种套餐形态，7/14/30/90 天档位，官方 App 页说明数据量 1-500GB，并有 7x24 客服。

购买与激活：网页或 App 选目的地套餐，App 内开通可一键激活（免扫码）；同一 eSIM 可反复充值，换目的地不必换卡。价格（2026-11-10 渲染目的地价目卡实核）：$4.99 起，同页可见 $5.99/$9.99/$19.99/$34.99/$57.99 等档位；具体流量额度在结算页绑定。

注意：作为大运营商产品，入门价高于转售品牌；促销代码（如 App 内 95 折）时效性强的以结算页为准；套餐名与额度的绑定要到下单最后一步才展示，比价时要有耐心。
